## Feature Description
**A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.**

## Problem Statement
**What problem does this feature solve? Is your feature request related to a problem?**
Example: I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution
**Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented.**

## Alternative Solutions
**Have you considered any alternative solutions or features? If so, please describe them.**

## Use Case
**Describe the use case(s) for this feature. Who would benefit and how?**

## Benefits
**What are the expected benefits of implementing this feature?**
- Improved user experience
- Better performance
- Enhanced functionality
- Other: [...]

## Implementation Considerations
**Are there any technical considerations, dependencies, or concerns to be aware of?**

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Priority
**How important is this feature to you?**
- [ ] Critical - Blocking my use of CIVWATCH
- [ ] High - Significantly improves my workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor enhancement
